channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Oil prices fall to levels not seen since start of US-Israel war on Iran
item.description: Brent falls below $71 a barrel amid reports of progress in talks to end the war.

item.title: At least 10 killed in Kyiv as Zelenskyy warns of ‘massive Russian strike’
item.description: At least 10 dead and dozens injured as Ukraine's forces defend against ballistic missiles, drones targeting capital.

item.title: Iran war live: ‘Positive progress’ as US, Tehran wrap up indirect talks
item.description: Tehran says a 'communication channel' will be established with Washington to report and discuss breaches of the MoU.

item.title: Iran football team welcomed home after World Cup exit
item.description: Iran’s football team has landed back in Tehran after their World Cup

item.title: Iran to open ‘communication channel’ on MoU with US after talks in Qatar
item.description: Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi says part of $6bn in frozen assets would be used to buy goods Tehran needs.

item.title: At least 13 killed in large-scale Russian missile and drone strikes on Kyiv
item.description: Russia launched its biggest strikes on the city in weeks with children among the "significant number" of casualties, Ukrainian officials say.

item.title: US envoys in Doha to meet mediators but not Iranians, Qatar says
item.description: Qatar's foreign ministry spokesman says no high-level meetings or direct talks between the US and Iran are scheduled.

item.title: Rescuers keep up search for survivors at collapsed La Guaira building
item.description: At least 1,700 people are known to have been killed in the disaster but hope remains that others can continue to be found alive.
